protocol.daily_marking: adjusted open/close price ratios; suspended positions carry last value
protocol.decision: after close; targets execute at next session open
protocol.execution_boundary: unadjusted BaoStock tradestatus; no board-limit queue model
protocol.label: next-session open to fifth-session close adjusted-price return
protocol.liquidity_limit: order notional capped by trailing mean traded amount times configured participation
protocol.regime: risk_on when CSI 300 20-session price return is nonnegative; otherwise risk_off
protocol.regime_fallback: global reliability until the state has enough matured windows
protocol.reliability: only matured five-session Rank IC before each after-close decision
protocol.ridge: three existing Agent scores, standardized using matured training rows only
protocol.risk_allocator: top-decile eligibility, inverse trailing volatility, weight and turnover caps
protocol.static_weights: first configured number of matured development windows, then frozen
protocol.universe: historical BaoStock membership snapshots as visible at each decision date
